messages:
sam (ceo): Quick AH follow-up: several folks asked why we lost recent enterprise pilots. Can we capture the top themes and immediate playbook changes?

anya (product): Short summary from product side: customers cited slow pilot onboarding, unclear performance guarantees, and lack of a simple per-tenant eval they can view.

julia (sales): Agreed. Also heard: security wants audited artifacts quickly and customers ask for a named technical contact during pilot. Pricing rarely came up.

eli (cs): CS will own a pilot fast-path checklist + named-POC template. I'll draft the checklist and a short email template for handoffs. ETA 3 business days.

maya (eng-infra): I'll prepare a minimal pilot kit (prebuilt image + Terraform quickstart + `run_pilot.sh`). If we scope to minimal customer-facing bits, ETA 6 business days.

noah (legal): Legal can prepare a short SOW/pilot clause template. Need Product/CS to define acceptance criteria examples so we can draft safe language. ETA 4 days once criteria in.

anya (product): Action items: Product -> tiny per-tenant eval snapshot (2-sprint canary), CS -> pilot checklist (3 days), Eng-Infra -> pilot kit (6 days), Legal -> SOW snippet (4 days). I'll own the backlog reprioritization.

julia (sales): Sales asks for a 1-pager 'why we win/lose' and a 30s elevator script to use on calls. Julia will draft the elevator and share in #sales-playbooks by EOD tomorrow.

sam (ceo): Good. Ops-bot, schedule a 30-min follow-up next Tue to confirm owners and close the short list of customers to pilot these changes with.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Pilot-playbook follow-up" Tue 10:00  Attendees: Sam, Anya, Julia, Eli, Maya, Noah.

eli (cs): I'll add a tracking card to the CS board and post progress updates to #customer-success. If any blocker arises, call it out in this thread.

anya (product): Thanks everyone. Please drop any direct customer quotes or acceptance-test examples here before COB so Legal/Product can include them in the SOW draft.
_meta: generated for dataset: all-hands Q&A about customer wins/losses and feedback loops
